newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta share index hits record 700.89 pts.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta share index hits record 700.89 pts.

text.p: The Jakarta composite share index hit a record 700.89 points in late afternoon trading on Wednesday on blue chip buying, brokers said.
Further fresh overseas buying of blue-chip stocks after the afternoon session opened helped push the index up, brokers said.
They said Bank Negara Indonesia and cigarette makers Sampoerna and Gudang Garam were the main buying targets.
Brokers said the Jakarta bourse might also benefit from a spill-over effect after they said an American securities house in the region revised its buying programme.
